title: Your Best Customer Is Not Your Reference Desk
excerpt: The customer helped once. Now another team wants a call, a quote and a logo. How do you make the next ask without taking their goodwill for granted?
primary_goal: Decide whether to make, reduce, replace or decline a specific customer reference request.
primary_cta: Use the Reference Request Note on one live request before the customer is approached.
playbook_description: A one-page check for the exact ask, customer time, permission and a smaller alternative.

subject_variants.label: primary
subject_variants.subject: Can we ask this customer again?
subject_variants.preheader: A useful reference request starts with the customer's time, not your deal deadline.
